scope: Responses resource-history recovery and Messages conversion. Empty-response retries and additional empty-output errors are removed.

windowsAdaptation.sharedRuntime: Windows uses the same Node.js recovery and conversion core verified on macOS.
windowsAdaptation.platformWork: PowerShell launch, environment forwarding, HTTP forwarding/conversion/recovery and process-tree termination verified on real Windows runners with PowerShell 7 and 5.1.
windowsAdaptation.acceptance: User clarified on 2026-10-25 that reproducing the intermittent upstream fault on Windows is not required to complete adaptation.

additionalExperimentsStopped: Stopped optional live-fault reproduction and extra installed-client CI work when the user clarified the Windows adaptation scope. No extra client job is shipped.

behavior.emptyOutput: Native responses are relayed unchanged; valid converted empty completions finish normally, without empty-output retries or additional 422/502 errors.
behavior.resourceRetries: Project once on the specific pre-output Azure resource error; replay the identical projected bytes for subsequent matching errors. Default 10 total upstream attempts with 1000ms delay, within the original request deadline and cancellation signal.
behavior.lastAttempt: Returns the actual upstream error rather than a synthetic recovery-exhausted status.
behavior.otherErrors: No generic replay of rate limits, authentication errors, unrelated 400s, output already delivered, unknown contents, or empty completions.

latestRegressionAddition: Mixed Codex custom-tool plus encrypted-reasoning history retains IDs, content and pairings across repeated known resource errors. Runtime hashes unchanged; previous CI suite had 381 tests.

ci.matrix: Ubuntu/macOS/Windows x Node 18/22/24: all 9 jobs successful; 381 tests, 381 passed, no failures or skips per job.
ci.windowsLauncher: Actual .ps1 execution, different working directory, HTTP passthrough, Messages conversion, resource recovery, process-tree termination and closed-listener checks.
ci.windowsPowerShell: PowerShell 7 in full suites; additional startup suites explicitly run under Windows PowerShell 5.1, successful on Node 18/22/24.

initialRun.failure: Both Windows startup tests timed out; missing shell environment caused unready launch and process hold. Repaired environment and preferred PowerShell engine, then reran successfully.

codexSingleToolInjectedRecovery.boundary: Earlier resource-only revision, before repeated-resource retry addition; exact history projection function unchanged. Fault was local injection, recovery response real AgentRouter.

encryptedTwoToolResponses.boundary: Compact inline history and explicit caller-provided prompt cache key; not actual Codex CLI and not a natural upstream fault.

codexMultitoolEarlierFailures.boundary: Earlier single-retry revision failed; later actual CLI attempts also hit upstream rate limits or generic invalid_request_error. Do not treat these as completed recovery.

codexRepeatedResourceReplay.lastError: Upstream rejected the request as invalid without resource-error detail.
codexRepeatedResourceReplay.boundary: Repeated recognized resource failures were retried as designed, but generic final 400 was not retried or misreported as success.

codexCustomIdCandidateInitial.boundary: Rate-limited before the second tool result and fault injection; provides no evidence for or against removing custom item IDs. Runtime field contract unchanged.

codexCustomIdCandidateSpaced.boundary: Candidate projection applied by the experiment outside the bridge, after the bridge's standard projection. Does not prove current runtime recovery or that custom IDs caused earlier failures. A later paced baseline preserving custom IDs passed without encrypted history, so it is not an encryption-matched control; runtime field contract unchanged.

codexCurrentBridgePacedBaseline.boundary: Current bridge directly recovered the paced two-tool CLI request, but this response history emitted no encrypted reasoning and cannot settle the encrypted-history gap.

codexCurrentBridgePacedRepeat.boundary: A second direct current-runtime two-tool replay passed; encrypted reasoning was not emitted and is not verified by this run.

codexPacedMediumEffortAttempt.boundary: Failed before the second tool result and injection; does not verify recovery. It is not retried by a broad 400 policy.

portabilityResearch.boundary: External documentation is background, not proof of AgentRouter routing or portability for this deployment. No encryption deletion, new affinity field, or runtime policy is inferred from it.
